Hi Ivy and Maha Mums. Thank you for reminding me why it's so important to speak out on this
platform because not only are you acting like you've uncovered some information all the world
scientists and doctors have missed but you're intentionally pushing this information that
can affect the medical decisions someone else makes for their child when you haven't spent
five minutes reading about vaccines because if you had you would know that metal mercury
which is the compound found in certain seafood, can accumulate within the body and be toxic at
relatively low doses, which is why it's not recommended during pregnancy, whereas epimercary
is a different compound that's rapidly excreted and is not toxic at low doses. The same is how
methanol and ethanol are also not the same compound. Although they're both simple alcohols,
methanol can kill or paralyze you, with very small amounts, and ethanol is readily used in beer,
wine, and kombucha. By Marisol, which is another compound used as a preservative,
hasn't been used in routine childhood vaccinations since 2001 and only remained in a multi-dose
version of flu vaccine given to less than 6% of the population and even now has been replaced
with another preservative. So no, your daughter would not be given a vaccine full of mercury
found in seafood or otherwise, but you are full of misinformation that you feel very comfortable
speaking on in an attempt to go in favor with this administration in order to try to stay relevant.
So grateful for the transparency that we have seen from this administration
but this is why it's important to actually read about something before you spread straight-up lies
that can affect medical decisions other people make for their children and jeopardize public health.
